title: Share and release keyed resources safely
instruction: Implement LeasePool as a keyed reference-counted context manager while preserving its constructor and lease API. key must be a non-empty string. Overlapping or nested leases for the same key share the exact resource and call acquire only once; distinct keys are independent. Release exactly once when the last lease for a key exits, including body exceptions and out-of-order exits. If acquire raises, record no state. If release raises, remove internal state before propagating so a later lease can acquire again. A context manager object may be entered only once. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-2 lifecycle lineage covering shared ownership, exception cleanup, and reusable pool state.
